_comment: Capability: retrieval — quoting back what a letter actually said, weeks later, at 9pm. Then a reminder placed early enough to avoid the Thursday-night costume build.

messages.text: what did the letter say about book week costumes? was it no bought ones or something?

From Friday’s letter: “For Book Week children may come dressed as a character from a favourite book. Costumes do not need to be bought — homemade is encouraged. Please, no football kits.”

That’s Friday 17 Oct. You’ve got two weeks.
he wants to go as the gruffalo
Brown jumper, cardboard horns, green pom-pom wart. I’ll remind you the weekend before, so it’s not a Thursday-night build. 📚
